name: Zunami zETH and UZD permissionless rebase price latch on spot-valued rewards
summary: Zunami's elastic vaults (zETH, UZD) let anyone call cacheAssetPrice, which latches the pool's lpPrice whenever it rises; strategy holdings count donatable reward tokens at spot DEX prices. The attacker donated CRV (zETH) and SDT (UZD) to strategies, pumped their spot prices, cached the inflated price, and sold rebased tokens into Curve pools.
notes: zETH and UZD share the ZunamiElasticRigidVault template with identical cacheAssetPrice; the same attacker contract hit zETH and then UZD 41 blocks apart, so the legs are one incident (rule 4) anchored on the earlier zETH leg.

The anchor's donated CRV was valued by strategy 0xc6a13d92 through reward manager 0x288f6170, set as its price source in the config reset (rule 8). The stEth strategy added to the pool later also values CRV at spot but was not needed for the exploit.
Loss is what the Curve zETH/frxETH, UZD/crvFRAX and UZD/crvUSD pools paid out against the inflated tokens.
